changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla topics: temas del curso (nodos del DAG de prerrequisitos) con subtemas, posición, origen y estado de revisión; el embedding vive en ai_embeddings. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría topics_audit y el trigger topics_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Course topics, nodes of the prerequisites DAG. Embeddings live in ai_embeddings

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: course_id
column.remarks: Course the topic belongs to

column.name: name
column.remarks: Topic name

column.name: description
column.remarks: Topic description

column.name: bloom_level
column.remarks: Bloom taxonomy level of the topic

column.name: subtopics
column.remarks: Subtopics as a JSON array

column.name: position
column.remarks: Position of the topic in the course

column.name: estimated_minutes
column.remarks: Estimated study time in minutes

column.name: is_mandatory
column.remarks: Whether the topic is mandatory and cannot be skipped

column.name: origin
column.remarks: Who created the topic: llm or instructor

column.name: review_status
column.remarks: Instructor review: unchanged, corrected, added or deleted

column.name: extraction_key
column.remarks: Snake_case id given by the LLM in the extraction

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_bloom_level_ck CHECK (bloom_level IS NULL OR bloom_level IN ('remember', 'understand', 'apply', 'analyze', 'evaluate', 'create'))
ALTER TABLE topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_origin_ck CHECK (origin IN ('llm', 'instructor'))
ALTER TABLE topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_review_status_ck CHECK (review_status IN ('unchanged', 'corrected', 'added', 'deleted'))
ALTER TABLE topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_subtopics_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(subtopics) = 'array')
ALTER TABLE topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_estimated_minutes_ck CHECK (estimated_minutes IS NULL OR estimated_minutes > 0)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX topics_course_extraction_key_uq ON topics (course_id, extraction_key) WHERE extraction_key IS NOT NULL
CREATE TRIGGER topics_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON topics FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in topics

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE topics_audit ADD CONSTRAINT topics_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER topics_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON topics FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS topics_audit_trg ON topics
